audit.whatIsWrong: Full phases[3..6].side read Skill/Ekko/Skill/Skill while content win[3..6] read Ekko/Azir/Ekko/Azir — four rows answering the same question twice.
audit.why: Packet levelChart matches the content layer and the kit supports it: Phase Dive's 9-7s blink owns 4-5, Emperor's Divide breaks the Convergence stun at 6, Chronobreak dropping to 80s takes the first-item window back.
audit.corrected: Ekko, Ekko, Skill, Ekko, Azir, Ekko, Azir on both layers, with every moved row's why rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] attributed his first-item spike to "Riftmaker/Night Harvester timers" — item names with nothing behind them.
audit.why: The real first-item edge is that Phase Dive resets his auto and gives him an exit, so he arrives and leaves inside one soldier cycle. Chronobreak also halves from 110s to 80s at rank 2.
audit.corrected: Spike restated on the kit's terms; Chronobreak cooldown numbers added to the level-6 spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit anywhere and the Phase Dive auto-reset tell was absent from the whole matchup.
audit.why: Timewinder 9/8.5/8/7.5/7 at 1075; Parallel Convergence 22/20/18/16/14 placed from 1600 away, forming after a delay and stunning only if Ekko enters it; Phase Dive 9/8.5/8/7.5/7 at 325 with an auto-attack reset — the charge, not the blink, is the cue; Chronobreak 110/80/50, untargetable and healing. Azir's R creates terrain, which is what breaks the Convergence entry.
audit.corrected: Numbers stated, the wind-up tell made the step-back rule, and R assigned to the Convergence entry rather than to waves.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grievous Wounds was never tied to Chronobreak.
audit.why: brief.missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal: Chronobreak heals for a percentage of damage received in the rewound window, so anti-heal is what makes your chip stick.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal folded into breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding and dosFull[0].d.

audit.why: Both packet suspectNames (Chronobreak, Parallel Convergence) are FALSE POSITIVES — they match the kit file exactly.
